meta.title: Cerne — personal and business finances
meta.description: Your personal and business finances consolidated in one ledger, to keep your money under control and reach financial freedom.

hero.title: Wealth grows in rings.
hero.lead: Your company and your personal life in one ledger. With everything consolidated you see what is really left over, stay in control and see the year you reach financial freedom.
hero.shot: Cerne's financial freedom screen: one ring of wealth per year, up to the goal

together.title: Two sets of accounts, one net worth.

apart.title: Kept apart, money gets lost on the way
apart.text: Owner's pay, profit distributions and expenses the company pays for you sit in different places. None of them shows how much you really save.

joined.title: Together, it all adds up
joined.text: Every transfer from the company to you has both sides recorded. You see one net worth and one savings rate, and can still look at just personal or just business.

plan.title: And the plan uses the whole
plan.text: Financial freedom is worked out on your entire net worth, not just your personal account.

together.shot: Cerne's transactions screen, with personal and company entries and a profit distribution from the company to the owner

who.title: For people whose company and life share one pocket.

abroad.title: Paid from abroad
abroad.text: The client pays in dollars into the company's account. Cerne keeps the original amount and what it was worth in reais that day.

business.title: A company and a personal account
business.text: Profit distributions leave the company and reach you, with both sides recorded. Nothing gets lost on the way.

goal.title: Wants to get there
goal.text: Contributions, portfolio and an income goal for financial freedom, in the same place as the month's spending.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Sync your accounts through Open Finance, or send the statement as a PDF or a screenshot.

check.title: Check
check.text: The assistant reads and proposes the transactions. Nothing enters your ledger without your confirmation, and everything can be undone later.

grow.title: Grow
grow.text: Watch each month's surplus turn into wealth. One ring a year, thicker in good years, but always a ring.

proposal.label: The assistant's proposal, with illustrative data

features.title: Everything money does, recorded the right way.

ledger.title: One ledger
ledger.text: You and your companies, with accounts, cards, brokerage and cash in the same place.

currencies.title: Many currencies
currencies.text: Each transaction keeps the original amount and the amount in reais, fixed on the day it came in.

cards.title: Cards on the right date
cards.text: A purchase counts when the statement closes, and paying the bill is a transfer, not a second expense.

investments.title: Investments
investments.text: Portfolio by asset class, contributions and income, next to the rest of your accounts.

budgets.title: Budgets and views
budgets.text: Goals per category for the month and the year. Table, pivot, chart, board and calendar, with saved filters.

claude.title: Works with Claude
claude.text: Ask and record through Claude: Cerne has an MCP server with the same rules as the app.

freedom.title: A plan, not just a chart.
freedom.text: Say how much income you want each month. Cerne works out what is missing, simulates thousands of market scenarios and shows the year you get there at your current pace. And how much an extra contribution brings it closer.
freedom.shot: The financial freedom panel: today's net worth, the expected year of arrival and how much a larger contribution brings it forward
freedom.demo: The real screen, with demo data.

confirm.title: Nothing goes in without you
confirm.text: The assistant can read a statement, but it does not import on its own. The proposal waits for your click and expires in 30 minutes.

undo.title: Everything can be undone
undo.text: Any change can be undone, whoever made it. What you delete stays 30 days in the trash.

export.title: Your data leaves with you
export.text: Export any view as CSV whenever you want. The ledger is yours.

access.title: Start the first ring.
access.text: Cerne is opening little by little. Write to us and we will let you know when it is your turn.
access.subject: Early access to Cerne
